summary: Frontend-only testing of new barcode/IMEI scanner integration in Kasir, Produk, Pembelian, Pelanggan (regression). All scan buttons open the shared BarcodeScanner dialog (data-testid=barcode-reader) without crashing. Kasir, Pembelian, Produk-modal fields (scan-sku/scan-imei), and Pelanggan (customer-scan-btn inside Tambah modal) all pass. One issue found: crud-scan-btn is MISSING on /produk search bar because Products.jsx does NOT pass scanSearch={true} to CrudResource, even though files_of_reference states 'scanSearch enabled'.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing crud-scan-btn next to search box. CrudResource only renders the scan-search button when scanSearch prop is true, but Products.jsx omits this prop. The review requirement 'Produk (/produk): Scan button next to search box (data-testid=crud-scan-btn)' is not met. Fix: pass scanSearch to <CrudResource ... scanSearch />.

action_items: Add `scanSearch` prop to <CrudResource> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Products.jsx so the crud-scan-btn appears next to the Produk search bar as required.
critical_code_review_comments: BarcodeScanner.jsx: cleanup() references stopped closure but onClose is called from cleanup; harmless but ensure onClose is stable across renders (currently fine).
Products.jsx missing scanSearch prop — likely a copy/paste oversight when adding scan-to-search.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (5/6 scan entry points working; 1 missing prop on Produk search)

seed_data_creation: None. No writes performed (production Atlas respected).
